notes: Share counts are the 'up to' amounts disclosed in the prospectus; affiliate sales remain subject to Rule 144 volume limitations after release.
The Second Trading Day Release Trigger was satisfied (first-day close of $311.07 exceeded 133% of the $185 IPO price), so 2.5M Non-Executive Employee shares unlocked on 2026-05-15.
The Q2 Earnings Release date (2026-09-04) is an estimate: the actual unlock is the second full trading day after Q2 2026 results, expected on 2026-09-02.
The final Lock-up Expiry is the earlier of the second trading day after the release of Q3 2026 results or 180 days after the prospectus date (2026-11-09); the earlier date is used.

The total reflects the post-offering share count from the prospectus (based on holdings as of 2025-12-31) plus the fully exercised over-allotment option. Shares issued since then via option exercises and RSU settlements (~226.5M outstanding as of July 2026) are not included.
